newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KPN'S CASEMA REACHES AGREEMENT ON LICENCE.
newsitem.headline: KPN'S CASEMA REACHES AGREEMENT ON LICENCE.

text.p: Royal PTT Nederland NV (KPN) and the Dutch government have reached full agreement on the conditions that cable operator Casema must meet to qualify for regional infrastructure licences.
KPN will change KPN Kabel BV, its subsidiary responsible for cable operations, into a joint stock company from January 1, 1997.
KPN will reduce its indirect interest in Casema, in which KPN Kabel currently has a 77 percent stake, to 20 percent shareholders' capital before July 1, 1998.
The restructuring of KPN Kabel into a joint company (Vision Networks) also means that KPN will no longer have access to information about KPN Kabel and Casema which is not available to third parties.
Vision Networks will publish its own annual report. From 1997 its financial results will no longer be consolidated in KPN's financial statements.
Only the dividend will be included in the results.
